tools.name: mithrandir_demo
tools.description: Run a free isolated synthetic Reuse Autopilot demonstration. No production account, upload, payment or private data is used. Compare unchanged, one-partition-changed and missing-source behavior before onboarding.

tools.name: mithrandir_gateway_trial_start
tools.description: Start a bounded free gateway test. Connect your public HTTPS MCP server, then approve safe reads and verify repetition before free Optimize activation.

tools.name: mithrandir_security_profile
tools.description: Free machine-readable description of the v17 Cognitive Membrane trust model: origin-bound authority, task-scoped exact-call capabilities, replay protection, egress control and two-phase effectful actions. This is a security contract description, not proof that a deployment is vulnerability-free.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mithrandir_pricing" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mithrandir_gateway_trial_start" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Start a bounded free Savings Gateway Observe trial for an unauthenticated public HTTPS MCP upstream. Read /service-contract and use its current policy_version before explicit terms acceptance. Keep the returned API key private. Observe always calls upstream and never debits credits. After connecting" → after: "Start a bounded free gateway test. Connect your public HTTPS MCP server, then approve safe reads and verify repetition before free Optimize activation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
